title: a deposit into a scratch leaf whose run has exited is refused, never re-minted as a standing table
intention: trees.ensure_trees refuses to mint a leaf table whose name has the scratch shape (<prefix>_<pid>_<HHMMSSffff>[_<suffix>], store.scratch_name) unless the cairn_scratch registry holds it, so a write that arrives after its scratch dropped is a loud refusal naming the table, never a standing table nothing will sweep.
why: Six testing_e8fe leaf tables (chart_ and codemother_) stand live with no scratch row. Their minter (codemother's deposit verb, scratch_nexus inside the handler) drops the scratch before it replies, so the table was made again after the drop by a write through ensure_trees, which mints any name it is given. HYPOTHESIS, labelled: which write re-makes it (a second owner's leaf in deposit_berth, or a late write) is the build's first measurement; the refusal closes every such path at the one door that mints.
traces_to: Law 7 (an error is loud at the door); Law 4 (the scratch rule enforced at the mint, not by each caller); ticket 201a37bf1613.
how: D0 (measured first, recorded on the ticket): reproduce one testing_e8fe leak under the codemother deposit proof (cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_the_chart_deposit_is_a_codemother_verb.py) and name the write that re-mints. D1: in ensure_trees, before create_owned_table for the leaf, a name matching store's scratch shape and absent from store.scratch_rows() raises TreeRefused naming the table and 'its scratch is gone'; the shared tables and standing names are untouched. scratch_leaf registers first and then ensures, so its own mint passes. D2: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause, over store.scratch only.

clauses.claim: a deposit into a scratch_nexus name after the with-block has exited raises TreeRefused naming the table, and no table of that name exists afterwards
a deposit inside the held scratch_nexus lands as before
a standing nexus name (no pid-stamp shape) is minted by ensure_trees as before
the write that re-made a testing_e8fe table (named by D0) now ends in that refusal, and the codemother deposit proof leaves no unregistered scratch-shaped table behind

decisions.text: D0+D1: the measurement, then the refusal in ensure_trees.

out: codemother's deposit verb and deposit.py (a fix to the re-making write, if D0 names one there, is codemother's own ticket; this one refuses it at the mint)
dropping the leaked tables standing now (a one-shot after both land)
06db586bedfd's rework of trees.py (land order: whichever lands second rebases)

measured.how: pg_tables over the live db beside store.scratch_rows() (empty for every one), by akienasus_cc_0; census by akiendelllinux_cc_0, relayed 2026-11-14

measured.saw: codemother's _handle_deposit wraps land() in scratch_nexus(scratch, owner='codemother') and replies after the drop; ensure_trees mints any leaf name through create_owned_table with no registry check
